The following events took place in '''25 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Horace Vancil/Legends|Horace Vancil]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Chommell sector/Legends|sector]], resigns and is replaced by the former [[Queen/Legends|Queen]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], whose prior position is then filled by [[Jamillia/Legends|Jamillia]].
*[[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] becomes Padmé's [[Junior Representative/Legends|Associate Planetary Representative]].
*A group of [[Yuuzhan Vong]] land on the obscure planet [[Bimmiel/Legends|Bimmiel]] and begin to survey the surrounding [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] in preparation for a future invasion.<ref name="EGASxi">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']], p. xi</ref>
*[[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] scouts find the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Isis/Legends|Isis]], but keep it a secret.
*Colonists settle on [[Thonner/Legends|Thonner]] in response to the discovery of freshwater vents on the planet.<ref name="Gamer9" />
*[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Djinn Altis/Legends|Djinn Altis]] arrives on [[Chad/Legends|Chad]] and initiates [[Callista Ming|Callista's]] [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="J14">{{JournalCite|14|Murder in Slushtime}}</ref>
*The [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] undergoes a desperately needed restoration.
*The [[Republic Group/Legends|Republic Group]] moves the [[Insignia of Unity]] from the Senate Rotunda and transfers it to [[Tandun III]].
*The [[Queen Mother]], a mercenary organization, is founded.<ref name="Special Ops: The Mercenary">{{GamerCite|8|Special Ops: The Mercenary}}</ref>
*The [[Virgillian Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Virgillian Free Alignment/Legends|Virgillian Free Alignment]] and the [[Aristocracy]], begins.<ref name="HNN" />
*[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] successfully capture the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Alysun Celz]] on the [[Poison Moon/Legends|Poison Moon]] after she [[Skirmish on the Poison Moon|tries]] to kill them.<ref name="Poison">{{StoryCite|story=Poison Moon (comic story)|book=Dark Horse Extra|bformatted=''Dark Horse Extra'' 44&ndash;47}}</ref>
